notes.title: Strange Jigsaws comes out in 1 week, on August 7th!
notes.content: [p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]My next game, "Strange Jigsaws" comes out in 1 week, on August 7th.[/p][p][/p][p]It's a game of strange jigsaws where you solve strange jigsaws.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26782931/d09fa7b92aa1f7044111e406d317ebf9b7298001.png"][/img][/p][p]There is a little bit of RYB in it, as you can see in the screenshot above, in the lower right.[/p][p][/p][p]You can wishlist it at the link here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702170/Strange_Jigsaws/"]Strange Jigsaws on Steam[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are well,[/p][p]FLEB[/p]

notes.title: New Free Game: 20 Small Mazes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been over 7 years...

If you haven't seen it yet, last week I released a new, free game called 20 Small Mazes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26782931/85f013cb43acde3a0a473e6b08d72cc4bcd494d7.png[/img]

It consists of 20 Small Mazes.

I hope you enjoy it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570630/20_Small_Mazes/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570630/20_Small_Mazes/[/url]


-----------------------------

Rock Paper Shotgun had some nice things to say about the game: [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/20-small-mazes-is-an-extremely-good-game-made-of-er-20-small-mazes-and-its-free]https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/20-small-mazes-is-an-extremely-good-game-made-of-er-20-small-mazes-and-its-free[/url]

20 Small Mazes was also an honorable mention for "excellence in design" at this year's IGF awards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26782931/0140f9159e46d0c9e599d40d581dfd068c1b605e.png[/img]

notes.title: RYB has been updated
notes.content:
This update brings the following:

1. In the settings menu there is now a brightness slider for the background, as requested by the community.

2. The animations have been smoothed, allowing for a more pleasant experience.

3. There are many performance optimizations, which should help the game run better on older machines.


Thank you!

FLEB
